number_of_accused.quote: The appeal filed by the appellant is totally devoid of any merit and is accordingly dismissed.

weapon.quote: Virendra Singh and Hakim Singh were armed with lathis and Kamlesh was armed with a rifle.

evidence_type.quote: Baburam P.W. 6 is an injured eye witness.

final_outcome.quote: The appeal filed by the appellant is totally devoid of any merit and is accordingly dismissed.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Replace 'the victim's mother, sister' with the mother and sister of the victim's beaten son, who rushed to protect him.

neutral_facts.reason: The summary misstates the relationships: the mother and sister are of the beaten son, not of the victim. Otherwise accurate and outcome-free.
